name: Electric Consumption And Cost (2010 - Sep 2025)
description:
This dataset contains monthly electricity billing records for New York City public housing developments, covering billing periods from 2010 through September 2025, with the sampled rows concentrated in August and September 2025. Each row represents a utility bill for a specific development, building, or meter, and includes the development name, borough, account name, location or building identifier, meter type and number, funding source, vendor, rate class, and service period dates. It also records electricity consumption in kilowatt-hours and kilowatts, along with the associated charges: current charges, kWh charges, kW charges, and other charges. Flags indicate whether a bill was estimated and whether it has been analyzed.

The data can be used to compare electricity use and costs across boroughs and developments, track consumption trends over time, identify high-cost or high-usage buildings, and examine how charges break down between energy, demand, and other fees. It is also useful for budgeting, auditing utility bills, and studying the effects
